title: Effigy Showcase - Full Workflow Video
author: CmdrCallandra
selftext:
I finally came along to create a full workflow video for my 3D / 2D asset generation tool Effigy. Everything in the pipeline runs 100% local and in this example I let claude do all the lifting, but each step can be done yourself, and you may also bring in your own 3D asset to run through it.

Needs at least 16GB VRAM, based on the model weight sizes, but tried to offload as much as possible whenever possible.

  
Repo is at : [GitHub - SifuInTheShell/Effigy: Fully local 2D/3D Asset generation · GitHub](https://github.com/SifuInTheShell/Effigy)

  
Hope this can be of help for you guys :-)
